params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { list?, backLabel?, none?, label? }.

params.name: OnAction
params.note: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked; Key is its key.

params.name: Load
params.doc: Loads one page of the list: receives the query (page, pageSize, sort, search, filters as JSON) and returns an object { rows, total }. Throwing shows the list's error state with Retry.

params.name: Close
params.doc: Back was pressed in the one-pane view: change the route to the list (NavigationManager.NavigateTo).

params.name: DetailContent
params.note: The selected record's content (read RecordId to render it): shown in the record pane only while RecordId is set.

notes: New component: App framework step 7 (issue #353). Load and Close are callbacks (PkCallbackSlot; Load asks the page to redraw, issue #1415). The record's pane lives in the element's shadow tree, so the mountDetail callback is the DetailContent slot instead: Blazor renders it as a light-DOM child the element projects. open(row) is not mapped: it returns an href synchronously, which cannot cross the interop boundary (PkListPage has the same limit and offers RowHrefTemplate); the row links come from Config list or the app's own list.
